subject: Integral Systems marketplace demo — cross-region timing & runbook
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@edgebridge.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@integral-si.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integral Systems marketplace demo — cross-region timing & runbook

Hi Samir / Lydia —

Thanks again for agreeing to do the joint marketplace demo with Integral Systems and AWS. We want to run a ~60–75 minute session that covers: a short customer-facing walkthrough (30m), an SI-led technical deep-dive (25m), and a 10m Q&A / next-steps segment.

To make scheduling easier across regions, propose these windows (all PDT):
- Option A: Wed 9/8 08:00–09:15 PDT (EAST APAC evening)
- Option B: Thu 9/9 16:00–17:15 PDT (EU morning / APAC midnight)
- Option C: Fri 9/10 23:00–00:15 PDT (APAC friendly)

Attachments: integral-demo-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook + roles), agenda-marketplace-demo.xlsx
Zoom link (placeholder): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=demo
HubSpot: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/HS-4231

Vanessa / Karthik — can you review the runbook and confirm who will facilitate the customer portion vs. the SI breakout? Also we should loop in AWS Marketplace Ops if we plan to reference listing mechanics during the session.

Samir / Lydia — which of the three windows works best for you? If none, happy to propose alternate APAC-centric slots next week.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Partner Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@edgebridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@integral-si.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 21:40:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Integral Systems marketplace demo — cross-region timing & runbook

Thanks Mina — appreciate the options. Quick note from my side: the proposed windows fall inconveniently for our APAC engineering team (they're on leave the first week of September).

Would it be possible to move the customer-facing portion to the following week with a slot around:
- Tue 9/14 21:30–22:45 IST (this maps to Wed 9/15 08:00–09:15 SGT / 01:00–02:15 PDT)

If that doesn't work for Redwood's calendar, we can do a split session: customer-facing at a time that favors US/EU and record the SI technical deep-dive for APAC to watch asynchronously, then run a live 30m follow-up for APAC the next day.

Also saw the runbook — looks good overall. Can we add a short slide for listicle: "What AWS Marketplace expects from SI listings"? I'll bring in Marketplace Ops if we lock a time.

Cheers,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Partnerships, EdgeBridge

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Integral Systems marketplace demo — cross-region timing & runbook

Team —

Thanks Samir for the heads-up. I propose a compromise to avoid multiple session fragmentation: we hold the live customer-facing demo at a US-friendly time and add a dedicated 30-minute APAC live follow-up the next calendar day (led by the SI). That keeps the same audience experience and gives APAC a proper live session.

Proposed schedule (all times shown with target local conversion in runbook):
- Live main demo (US/EU): Wed 9/15 09:00–10:15 PDT — Redwood will facilitate the first 30m, then SI joins for 25m technical deep-dive, 20m Q&A.
- APAC follow-up: Thu 9/16 20:30–21:00 SGT — SI-led focused technical follow-up for APAC attendees (30m).

Karthik — can you host the SI technical deep-dive on the main session and be lead for the APAC follow-up? Aditya — please hold both slots tentatively on the calendar and prepare the recording instructions; we should have local notes in the runbook indicating where we'll cut for the APAC call.

I'll draft an invite once Mina confirms with Samir/Lydia and I can loop in AWS Marketplace Ops.

V
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Integral Systems marketplace demo — cross-region timing & runbook

Yep, I can take the SI deep-dive on the main session and run the APAC follow-up. A couple quick asks:
- Please add a 5-minute handoff slide in the runbook so SI knows exactly when to start the deep dive.
- I want a 10-minute "marketplace checklist" segment to be shown before the technical demo (to orient ops folks).

I'll prep a short run-of-show deck; Aditya — can you confirm recording + transcription will be enabled and that we have a follow-up calendar placeholder for the APAC slot?

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@integral-si.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>, Samir Patel <samir@edgebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 15:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Integral Systems marketplace demo — cross-region timing & runbook

Thanks everyone — Wed 9/15 for the main session + Thu 9/16 APAC follow-up works for us. A couple of notes from the SI side:
- We need an extra 30 minutes on the main session (so total 90m) to cover an extended architecture walkthrough if the customer asks for deeper details. Is Redwood OK with a 90-minute block?
- Please include AWS Marketplace Ops on the main invite (cc'd) — they may want 10 minutes to cover listing timeline and requirements.
- We'll send a short pre-call checklist (permissions, exemplar tenant access) by Friday.

Attachment: integral-demo-runbook-v1.pdf (updated with page comments)

I'll add the calendar invites once Mina confirms the final time stamps; otherwise, looks good from our side.

Best,
Lydia Park
Director of Integrations
Integral Systems
